name: WeChat-AI
tagline: Self-hosted WeChat roleplay chatbot with a user center, chatflow orchestration, and multi-node support
description: WeChat-AI is a self-hosted WeChat roleplay chatbot service. It connects directly to Tencent iLink, stores data in remote Redis, and authenticates with LINUX DO OAuth. A user center lets people scan a QR code to add or remove WeChat bots, approve chat peers, and assign personas, while a visual chatflow builder orchestrates conversations. It supports multi-node deployment behind a Cloudflare Worker load balancer and ships OTA incremental updates. The README is bilingual (Chinese/English).
highlights: Self-hosted WeChat roleplay chatbot connecting to Tencent iLink
User center: scan-QR bot management, peer approval, and persona assignment
Multi-node deployment with a Cloudflare Worker load balancer
curatorNote: WeChat automation is an entire ecosystem Western tooling ignores, and this repo attacks it head-on with real architecture: iLink connectivity, Redis-backed state, a user center, and multi-node load balancing. The star growth says the niche was starving for this.
